title: Architecture
tagline: Buildings and their architects from the Parthenon to the present
intro: Western architecture from the temples of ancient Greece to the present, told through the buildings themselves and the people who designed them. Every architect or builder has a full biography and every building a detailed introduction, with photographs from Wikimedia Commons. Where a medieval or ancient builder is unknown, buildings are grouped under a collective entry.
